questions.q: At 6:20 P.M., what does Mr. Reyna most likely mean when he writes, "That did it"?

He was able to get into the office.

questions.q: Who most likely is Ms. Anand?

An employee at Halvorsen Dental
A technician who installs medical equipment
The driver of a company van

It usually finishes repairs in a day or less.
It rents only mountain bikes.
It offers discounts to first-time customers.

해석: 스포크웰 사이클 웍스에 대해 언급된 것은?

touch
carry
hold

questions.q: The word "secure" in paragraph 2, line 2, is closest in meaning to
